question.text: Market Cap to GDP ratio of 110%+ typically signals:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per textbook bands: 90-110% moderately overvalued; >110% overvalued. The Trap: Under 50% is undervalued. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 18. Manager's Pro-Tip: Context matters — interest-rate environment affects the 'right' M-Cap-to-GDP.
